import fs = require('node:fs');

/** Colors. */
export enum Color {
  Red,
}

/** A namespace with runtime members. */
export namespace Runtime {
  export const value = 1;
}

/** A type-only namespace, which is erasable. */
export namespace TypesOnly {
  export interface Shape { readonly sides: number; }
  export type Name = string;
}
declare namespace Ambient {
  const declared: number;
  enum Inner { C }
}
declare enum AmbientEnum {
  A,
}
declare global {
  enum Global { B }
}
declare class AmbientClass {
  constructor(public x: number);
}

/** A point with parameter properties. */
export class Point {
  constructor(public x: number, private readonly y: number) {}
}

const length = <number>fs.readFileSync('x').length;

export = length;
